rules: Existing user-final approvals remain frozen and have not been modified.
Newly user-approved choices are final editorial hero selections, subject to rights and image-master release checks.
MAYBE is a live shortlist, not a final approval.
REJECT is specific to that module as a hero; artwork may be repurposed elsewhere.
Unreviewed choices are not implicitly rejected.
No changes to the GitHub repository or production app are represented by this ledger.
Explicit undecided status for Guercino The Woman Taken in Adultery is preserved as undecided, not rejected.
Evening Prayer previously recorded MAYBE candidates remain available as alternates and are not overwritten by the newly approved final hero.
Our Lady of Perpetual Help approved poster reproduction does not constitute image-rights/master-file release clearance; original Roman icon remains the devotional reference.
Saints round8: undecided works remain undecided, Rubens All Saints retains MAYBE, and Van Eyck Adoration of Mystic Lamb holds MAYBE specifically for Saints.
Seven Sorrows round9: five reviewed decisions recorded without promoting a hero; UNDECIDED does not mean rejection; all rejects module specific; previously marked maybes retained.

Visit to Blessed Sacrament round10: Nativity adoration artwork is typological/devotional, not historical representation of Eucharistic visits. All previous approvals and maybes preserved; no hero promoted because none approved. Rejections specific to module only.

Mass Explorer round11 has two separately user-approved paintings. Both are approved editorial choices; neither is designated the sole permanent hero until user selects primary or approves a multi-image presentation. Do not silently discard one or claim a single frozen hero.

Gallegos exact object/date/source master pending. A 19th-century piece titled The Mass is documented by Christie's signed 1895, but identity match to the preview reviewed is unverified. An online catalogue labels another image 1859 despite artist lifespan; do not transfer that date.

Round13 Holy Rosary: five candidates explicitly rejected as Rosary HERO only; four prior original maybes and prior five rejections retained without change; approval total unchanged at 17 single-primary heroes.

Round14 Seven Sorrows: five new works rejected for Seven Sorrows hero only; 4 previous MAYBEs retained (including two round9 and two older); 3 round9 UNDECIDED preserved, and permanent hero remains unselected.

Round15 Visit: Gerrit van Honthorst, The Adoration of the Shepherds (1622), Cologne, user-approved as sole permanent hero. This is a devotional analogy of the adoration of Christ; it is not a depiction of a visit to the tabernacle.

Round15 Visit: retain all six prior Visit MAYBEs (La Tour, Rubens, Dolci, Velázquez, Guido Reni, Jordaens); retain Correggio and Murillo and this round’s Zurbarán, Mantegna, Maíno UNDECIDED; previous Lanchares and this round El Greco remain module-specific REJECT.

Final-selection gate: 18 modules have single user-selected permanent heroes; Mass Explorer alone has two user-approved alternatives and no designated primary; Confession, Holy Rosary, Seven Sorrows have no approved hero. Avoid converting MAYBE or UNDECIDED to approved without user instruction.

Round16 final choice: Victor Meirelles The First Mass in Brazil is the single selected Mass Explorer primary. José Gallegos y Arnosa La misa remains APPROVED editorial alternative, never rejected. Unselected MAYBE and UNDECIDED candidates and all module-scoped rejections remain unchanged.

Round16 no final choices for Confession, Holy Rosary, or Seven Sorrows. Do not promote their maybes or undecided works without further express approval. Source identities, original image quality and reproduction-rights gates remain independent of editorial primary selection.
Review19 locks the final editorial primary for all 22 modules. Publication image rights/master validation and deployment are separate gates.
